verdict.rationale: Devin ships an official Devin CLI, documented as a local command-line coding agent with deep Devin Cloud integration. The docs show an invocation example and a --sandbox flag for OS-level isolation, and a probe independently confirms the official CLI docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the CLI, and evidence of broader command, install and auth coverage beyond the sandbox flag and a basic prompt example.
